title: Construct coherent shifts from zero and addition core data
statement:
Let $C$ be a category [def-nagata-category] and $A$ an additive monoid, with independent universes. For each $a\in A$ let $F_a:C\to C$ be a functor. Suppose given natural isomorphisms $z:F_0\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}_C$ and $c_{a,b}:F_{a+b}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_bF_a$. Assume, for all $a,b,d\in A$ and $X\in C$,
$$F_d(c_{a,b,X})\circ c_{a+b,d,X}=c_{b,d,F_aX}\circ c_{a,b+d,X},$$
$$c_{0,a,X}=F_a(z_X^{-1}),\qquad c_{a,0,X}=z_{F_aX}^{-1},$$
where the equalities use the canonical transports along associativity and unit equalities in $A$. There is a coherent shift structure $\mathrm{HasShift}(C,A)$ whose shift functor at $a$ is $F_a$, whose shift-zero isomorphism is $z$, and whose shift-add isomorphism is $c_{a,b}$. Here a coherent shift structure means a monoidal functor from the discrete monoidal category of $A$ [def-sfb-monoidal-category] to the category of endofunctors of $C$, with the stated zero and addition identifications.
